firstPlayerRule: Stack the Influence markers in random order, then arrange the Heron tokens in that same order. The player whose Influence marker is on top plays first.
clarifications: Choose starting card pairs in reverse turn order during setup. During play, follow the Heron tokens on the Turn Order track.
